headline: The sounds your newborn is making right now that you'll forget by winter
items: The squeak they make stretching, somewhere between a hinge and a bird
The effort noises in their sleep, like the dreaming is hard work
The catch in their breath just before they really cry
The hum against your shoulder that isn't quite a word yet, but nearly

cta.eyebrow: Photos keep the face. Nothing keeps the sound.
cta.ask: So give this year a song of its own, written just for *them*
